views.name: country_year_population
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  country_code,
  country_name,
  year,
  midyear_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population`
grain: country_code, year -- one row per country_code + year
views.description: Normalized yearly population facts: one row per country_code + year with canonical country_name and midyear_population, useful as the base population timeseries for trend analysis or joins to rates/age distributions. | Use for: time series of total population by country or global aggregates; join population to rates (birth/death/growth) to compute counts; filter latest/earliest year per country (downstream RANK or WHERE)
